intro: This is what the site platform already has, in design words. Everything here can be styled freely: colour, type, spacing, shape, shadow and motion are yours, and so is the layout around and inside each thing. The list is about what a thing is and how it works, not how it looks.
Before drawing a section, widget or control that works differently from everything here, say it would have to be built and ask first.

Any text can carry bold, italic, strikethrough, links and line breaks, a highlighter stripe behind words, and a small photo inside a line. Any box can have a hover lift, an entrance as it scrolls into view, and a looping or scroll-linked effect.
groups: Things that open, switch or move

entries.name: Section or box
entries.is: A band or box that holds anything, laid out as a stack, a row or a grid, at full width or at a set content width, with a colour, gradient, photo, video or drawn background.

can.say: become a row that scrolls sideways, with arrows, dots and drag
lift as one card on hover

entries.name: Hero
entries.is: The opening section of a page: a headline, a supporting line and calls to action, over or beside a picture, video or drawn graphic.

entries.name: Floating decoration
entries.is: A picture, a word, a label or a badge floated over its section at a set position, size and angle.

can.say: be mirrored
fade as the page scrolls

entries.name: Divider
entries.is: A horizontal line between parts, in any thickness, width, colour or gradient.

entries.name: Playful section
entries.is: A section whose decorative items can be picked up and thrown about.

entries.name: Heading
entries.is: A heading at any of six levels, or a sub-heading line.

entries.name: Text
entries.is: A paragraph of body text.

can.say: open with a large first letter
fold behind a Read more and Read less control

entries.name: Label, eyebrow or badge
entries.is: A short kicker above a heading, a pill, a tag or a badge.

entries.name: Quote
entries.is: A pulled quote of one or more paragraphs.

can.say: name who said it

entries.name: Picture, video or drawn graphic
entries.is: One photo, video, embedded player or drawn graphic, with a different file for phone, tablet and desktop where the design needs one. It can be cropped to a shape, framed, captioned and linked.

entries.name: Gallery
entries.is: Several pictures as a grid, a staggered wall or a carousel.

can.say: open a picture large over the page
show captions
play by itself, with arrows, dots and a pause control

entries.name: Before and after
entries.is: Two pictures or videos compared by dragging a divider across them.

can.say: label each side

entries.name: Icon
entries.is: An icon, an emoji or a drawn mark, bare or inside a shaped background, with an optional label.

entries.name: Button and button row
entries.is: A button or link in the versions your Button component declares, alone or in a row that stacks or wraps on small screens.

entries.name: Animated number
entries.is: A number that counts up when it comes into view, with a prefix, a suffix and a label.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.is: A countdown to a date, or one that starts fresh for each visitor.

entries.name: Audio player
entries.is: A sound player.

say.toggle: a sound on and off button

entries.name: Measured drawing
entries.is: A drawing with labelled measurement lines over it.

say.numbered: numbered, with a key beside it

entries.name: Scroll-played picture sequence
entries.is: A run of frames that plays forwards and backwards as the page scrolls, like a product turning.

entries.name: Contents list
entries.is: A list of the page's headings that jumps to each and marks where the reader is.

entries.name: Live clock, dark mode switch, language and country links
entries.is: Small working parts: a clock for one time zone, a light and dark switch, a list of language links, and a country or store chooser.

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Accordion
entries.is: Rows that open to show an answer: FAQs, product details, policies. Each answer can hold anything.

can.say: keep several rows open, or one at a time
be narrowed by a search box
be narrowed by topic chips
show a topic above each question

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Tabs
entries.is: A row or column of tabs, one panel showing at a time. Each panel can hold anything.

say.row: tabs stay in a row that scrolls

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Review or quote slider
entries.is: Customer reviews or quotes as a slider, or a single one standing alone. Each holds the quote, a name, a role and organisation, a rating, a photo, a logo and a work picture, each optional.

say.scale: a score out of a number

can.say: play by itself, with a pause control
show arrows
show dots

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Timeline
entries.is: Dated or numbered moments along a line.

say.scrub: the line fills with the scroll
say.pinned-journey: the section holds still while the entries pass
say.pinned-horizontal: the section holds still and travels sideways

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Numbered steps
entries.is: The steps of a process in a row, each with a number, a title and a line of text.

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Pop-up
entries.is: A panel that opens over the page from a button or link and holds anything. It closes with its close control, the Escape key or a click outside.

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Notice or announcement strip
entries.is: A message in the page, a bar across it, or an announcement strip above the header.

can.say: be closed by the visitor

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Choice chips
entries.is: A set of pills or tiles where the visitor picks one: a pack size, a flavour, a colour, a plan.

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Step-by-step chooser
entries.is: A run of questions where each answer can lead to a different next question, ending in a recommendation, an add to basket or an email. It can show a running price and summary.

say.compact: every question visible in the page
say.showcase: one question at a time, large

entries.group: Things that open, switch or move
entries.name: Live message preview
entries.is: Text boxes whose typing appears live elsewhere on the page, such as a gift note on a card.

entries.name: Card grid
entries.is: A grid of cards, each with a picture, a title, text and a link.

say.cpt-collection: a collection of the site's own items

entries.name: Feature cards
entries.is: Benefit or feature cards, each with an icon or picture, a title, a sub-title, text and a button, in any order.

say.auto-flex: cards wrap to fit the width

entries.name: List
entries.is: A list of lines or links, with an optional heading.
entries.cannot: Letters or Roman numerals, a list that starts from a chosen number or counts down, and items laid out across columns row by row.

entries.name: Blog and article grid
entries.is: Posts as a grid, a list, a staggered wall or a carousel, each with a picture, title, extract, date, author and category, each optional.

can.say: be filtered by category or tag

entries.name: Pricing table
entries.is: Plans side by side, each with a price, a feature list, a button and an optional badge.

entries.name: Team member
entries.is: A person's card: photo, name, role, a short biography and social links.

entries.name: Trust strip
entries.is: A full-width strip of short trust points, such as accreditations and delivery promises. It can sit still or scroll as a ticker.

entries.name: Logo strip
entries.is: A row of brand or partner logos, still or scrolling for ever, with faded edges.

say.logo-else-text: a logo, or the name where there is none

entries.name: Google and Trustpilot reviews
entries.is: Reviews pulled from Google or Trustpilot, and a compact Google rating badge. These keep the platform's own look, so draw them only where the design means to show that platform; reviews in the client's own style are the review slider.

entries.name: Star rating
entries.is: Stars, with half stars.

say.stars-with-value-and-count: stars, the score and the number of reviews

entries.name: Business details
entries.is: The business's phone, email, address, opening hours, an open-now line and a map, kept in one place and shown wherever they are drawn.

say.condensed: days with the same hours grouped

entries.name: Social and contact icons
entries.is: A row of icons linking to the business's phone, email, address and social profiles.

say.brand: each network's own colour as the background
say.brand-glyph: each network's own colour on the icon

entries.name: WhatsApp button
entries.is: A way to start a WhatsApp chat.

say.floating: a button floating in a corner

entries.name: Form
entries.is: A form in one page or several steps, with a sent message, error messages and emails to the owner and the sender. Fields: short text, email, phone, number, date, long text with a character count, dropdown, a pick-one group, a tick-box group, a consent tick, picture tiles, file upload and address.

say.inside: inside the box, moving up when typed in

can.say: show a step count
keep a half-filled form for the visitor's return
end with a review of the answers, each with an Edit link

entries.name: Header
entries.is: The site header in up to three rows: a strip above, the main bar, and a strip below. It can stick, shrink as the page scrolls, blur what passes behind it and sit transparent over the first section.

entries.name: Navigation bar and mega menus
entries.is: A row of links that becomes a burger below a chosen width. An item can open a simple drop-down or a wide panel of link columns, cards or brands with a featured side panel.

entries.name: Menu drawer
entries.is: The panel the burger opens, holding the menu and anything else: a logo, a search, contact icons, a rating, buttons.

say.header-box: as a box under the header

entries.name: Footer
entries.is: The site footer in up to three rows: a strip above, a grid of up to six columns, and a bottom bar.

entries.name: Logo
entries.is: The logo, with a different file for desktop, tablet and phone where the design needs one, and an optional drawn-on animation.

entries.name: Breadcrumbs
entries.is: The trail of pages above the current one, made from the site's own structure.

entries.name: Search
entries.is: A search box that suggests products as the visitor types.

say.inline-bar: a bar in the page or header
say.icon-expand: an icon that opens into a box
say.full-screen-overlay: an icon that opens a full-screen search
say.command-palette: a quick-find box opened from the keyboard

entries.name: Product card
entries.is: A product in a grid or carousel: photo, name, price, rating, badges, option pills and one or two buttons.

entries.name: Buy box
entries.is: The buying area of a product page: gallery, name, price, option choices, quantity and add to basket.

can.say: keep an add-to-basket bar in view as the page scrolls
show stock
offer a tell-me-when-it-is-back form on a sold-out product

entries.name: Basket
entries.is: The header's basket control with its live count, opening a small panel or a drawer of the basket's lines. With it: a free-delivery progress bar, a gift switch with a recipient and note, a line of small print with a link, and a pay-later message.

say.flyout: a small panel under the control

entries.name: Account
entries.is: Sign in, create account and lost password, then the account: a dashboard, orders, one order with its items, addresses, account details and saved items.

entries.name: Saved items
entries.is: A heart control with a live count, and the list of saved products with move to basket, tell me when it is back, and remove.

entries.name: Product questions
entries.is: Questions and answers for a product page, as rows that open.

entries.name: Filter search
entries.is: A type-to-find box that narrows a long list of filter choices, such as brands.
